questionText:

"Bharmaur tribal area comprises Bharmaur and Holi tehsils of Chamba district in Himachal Pradesh. Situated between 1,500 m and 3,700 m altitude in the Pir Panjal and Dhauladhar ranges, Bharmaur faces harsh climatic conditions, low resource base, and fragile ecology.
